confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Chania in July peak season, not based on live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain because summer rates vary widely by location, booking window and season. FX provenance: the 0.6955 rate came from a search-result excerpt of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page (as at 4.00 pm, 15 October 2026). I did not open that page directly, and I did not retrieve the full F11.1 daily series.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Crete's tourist towns (Rethymno and Heraklion) and other mid-sized Greek island tourism centres, adjusted for Chania's older-town dining and July peak-season hotel and hostel pricing.
